gemini.name: Google Gemini
gemini.steps: Sign in with Google → Get API Key → Create API Key → copy (starts with AIza). Open →

groq.name: Groq
groq.steps: Sign up free → API Keys → Create API Key → copy (starts with gsk_). Open →

deepseek.name: DeepSeek
deepseek.steps:
Sign up → API Keys → Create → copy (starts with sk-). Paid, but very cheap — add a small credit first. Open →
⚠ This provider does not reliably allow direct browser calls — it may fail even with a valid, funded key. Prefer Gemini, Groq, or OpenRouter.

openrouter.name: OpenRouter
openrouter.steps: Sign up → Keys → Create Key → copy (starts with sk-or-). Free models available. Open →

openai.name: ChatGPT (OpenAI)
openai.steps:
Sign up → API keys → Create new secret key → copy (starts with sk-). Paid — add billing credit first (from ~$5). Open →
⚠ OpenAI's API blocks direct calls from a web page like this one (no browser access). This key will not work here — it needs a server in between. Use Gemini, Groq, or OpenRouter instead.

claude.name: Claude (Anthropic)
claude.steps: Sign up → API keys → Create key → copy (starts with sk-ant-). Paid — add billing credit first. Open →
